categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies src/httpserver.cpp and src/httpserver.h to fix HTTP connection exhaustion.
categories.rationale: Fixes a connection exhaustion DoS in the HTTP server where slow-trickle clients can tie up all connection slots indefinitely before authentication. As demonstrated in the PR description, a client trickling bytes one at a time resets the inactivity timer, causing 'bitcoin-cli getblockcount' to hang once the connection slots are exhausted.
